member.name: T:Pxl.Ui.CSharp.Advanced.ShaderPaint
member.summary:
A custom paint backed by a raw SkiaSharp shader. This is the escape hatch for effects that the Pxl paint library does not yet expose. Reach for this only when you need a Skia construct (e.g. a custom SKSL shader, a special blend, an exotic gradient) that no Paints.X(...) factory provides.
Pixogram authors using this couple to SkiaSharp directly — that's what the Pxl.Ui.CSharp.Advanced namespace signals.

member.name: T:Pxl.Ui.CSharp.Advanced.SkiaInterop
member.summary:
Conversion helpers for stepping out of the Pxl API into raw SkiaSharp.
Using anything here means your pixogram is coupled to SkiaSharp directly — that's exactly what the Pxl.Ui.CSharp.Advanced namespace signals. Reach for this only when no Paints.X(...) factory or other Pxl primitive does what you need.

member.name: T:Pxl.Ui.CSharp.Color
member.summary:
Represents a color with RGBA components.
The Color struct provides a double-based public API (0.0 to 1.0 range) while internally storing the color as a single uint in ARGB format, matching 's representation for zero-cost conversion.
